question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Candid
solution:
The correct answer is '**Tactful**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Candid**' is '**Tactful**'.
 
• **Candid**: saying exactly what you think. (स्‍पष्‍टवादी, तटस्‍थ, खरा)
 
 
• *Example: His responses were remarkably **candid**. *
 
 
 
• **Tactful**: careful not to say or do things that could offend people. [व्‍यवहार-कुशल (लोगों को नाराज़ कर सकने वाली बातें न कहने या करने वाला), चतुर]
 
 
• *Example: They need a **tactful** word of advice.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:**__ *Tactful.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Honest**: (used about a person) telling the truth; not lying to people or stealing. [(व्‍यक्ति) सत्‍याचरण करने वाला, ईमानदार; चोरी आदि असत्‍याचरण न करने वाला]
 
• **Blunt**: (used about a knife, pencil, tool, etc.) without a sharp edge or point. [(चाक़ू आदि) कुंद, भोथरा]
 
• **Simple**: easy to understand, do or use; not difficult or complicated. (समझने, करने या प्रयोग करने में आसान, सुबोध, सुकर; कठिन या जटिल नहीं, सरल)
